s805_scope: DL-016 ExplanationWrong remediation on 58 Pack A Section E Certified items
rationale: S804 clone rationalization is 100% complete (17/17 Section E clone items Archived, up from 16 at S804 start — P1-E-051 was the 17th, Archived during S804 per Agent F seed selection). However, DL-016 metadata-block ExplanationWrong shift persists on ALL 58 remaining Certified Section E items. Every wrong-answer distractor explanation in Section E describes the PREVIOUS QID's topic, not the item the learner actually answered. This is a HIGH learner-safety risk that clone archival alone does not address. The correct approach: fix the metadata-content misalignment so learners receive topic-correct distractor feedback.

The learner cannot self-correct because the feedback addresses the wrong concept entirely.

why_clone_archival_alone_is_insufficient.clone_item_impact: Archiving 17 clone siblings removed learner-pool redundancy (9→0 direct clone duplicates in delivery pool). But clones were only 17 of 75 Section E items.
why_clone_archival_alone_is_insufficient.remaining_surface: 58 Certified items remain. 100% carry DL-016. That's 58 × 3 = 174 distractor explanation slots, all describing the WRONG item's choices.
why_clone_archival_alone_is_insufficient.severity_hierarchy: DL-016 (wrong-topic explanations) > clone redundancy (duplicate stems) in learner-safety terms. A duplicate stem is wasteful but not misleading. Wrong-topic feedback is educationally damaging — it teaches the wrong concept.

remediation_approach.root_cause: Pack A dual-block architecture. Block 1 (metadata) stores ExplanationWrongA-D + ChoiceA-D. Block 2 (content) stores Stem + Choices.A-D + CorrectChoice + ExplanationCorrect. Due to +1 offset from template rotation, Block 1 EW fields describe the previous QID's choices.
remediation_approach.fix_strategy: For each of the 58 Certified Section E items, align the metadata-block ExplanationWrongA-D text to match the content-block Choices.A-D. This requires per-item authoring: extract the item's actual distractors from Block 2, verify against the item's topic, and write choice-specific EW text for each of the 3 non-CorrectChoice slots.
constraints: Do NOT alter CorrectChoice — answer keys are correct in the content block
Do NOT alter Block 2 content (Stem, Choices, ExplanationCorrect) — these are correct
Ensure each EW field describes WHY that specific distractor is wrong for THIS item's topic
Backup mandatory per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md before each batch
Verify topic alignment per-item after each batch
